summary: Only publicly listed shelters may be surfaced: the CLI must fetch the Red Cross hidden set (hide_from_public other than 'No') and drop any matching site from every source, including sites FEMA's public feed still lists.
reason: The two feeds disagree about visibility. The Red Cross withholds operational-only and not-cleared-for-walk-in sites from its public map, but FEMA's OpenShelters mirror can still carry them, so a union of the two feeds re-publishes a location its operator deliberately hid. The occupancy overlay is fill-only for the same reason: it adds population onto shelters already public and never introduces a site.
validated_outcome: TestSuppressHidden asserts a FEMA-public but Red-Cross-hidden shelter is removed while a non-hidden FEMA shelter is kept; TestApplyHiddenSuppression covers the skip, success, and fetch-error degrade paths.
